page.overview:
Who is Bogey 3856?

Bogey 3856 was a clone trooper and member of Bogey Squad during the Great Jedi Purge on Kashyyyk. Under Clone Commander Faie, 3856 and his squad hunted down Jedi Master Quinlan Vos after he survived the initial Order 66 attack. The lone clone trooper was beheaded by the Jedi while stalking him in a lake.
